description: Python library, data pipeline, analytics, or ML project.

defaults.engineering.command_contract.unit: uv run --with pytest==8.4.1 --with pytest-cov==6.2.1 --with hypothesis==6.138.13 python -m pytest --cov=. --cov-branch --cov-report=term-missing -m 'not integration'
defaults.engineering.command_contract.integration: uv run --with pytest==8.4.1 python -m pytest -m integration
defaults.engineering.command_contract.package_smo: not-applicable: configure when a Python product artifact exists

questions: What is the as-of, revision, and provenance model?
Which datasets are public, licensed, synthetic, or confidential?
What naive baseline and held-out evaluation are required?
